thread:
acme_prod_eng: Hey team — since yesterday's model swap our ingest pipeline is failing. Indexer returns dimension errors and throughput is tanking. Example error: "embed_insert: dimension_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024". 100s/ min failures, some succeed.

sara_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a raw failure payload and the model id & tag you're calling? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

acme_prod_eng: We're on hosted API, model header X-Model-ID: rwd-embed-legacy-v2:2026-03-16, calling /v1/embeddings in batches of 32. Quick curl that reproduces:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Model-ID: rwd-embed-legacy-v2:2026-03-16' \
  -d '{"input":["doc1","doc2"], "batch_size":32}' | jq .
```

acme_prod_eng: Payload snippet from indexer logs: 
```
ERROR indexer: failed insert id=doc_123 err="dimension_mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024"
trace: insertBatch -> normalize -> validateShape
```

jessica_ml: Quick hypothesis: those numbers look like a model swap changed the embed dimensionality (1024) vs our vecdb schema (1536). Did the model catalog rollout create a compatible alias? If some requests still target the older version you'll see mixed dims.

mike_eng: Also saw elevated 401/403 spikes in the same window — looks like a short auth token expiry from the rotation at 02:10 UTC. Retries might have caused partial batches to be queued and then replayed to a different model variant. Putting both events together could explain intermittent succeeds.

ryan_oncall: Ops bot shows a deploy at 02:08 and a token-rotation job at 02:09. ops_bot: Deploy(rwd-embed-legacy-v2 -> rwd-embed-optimized-v3) completed, TokenRotate(service:embed-proxy) completed.

sara_support: For immediate triage can you do two quick checks and paste results?
1) sample the raw embeddings for a known doc: `curl ... | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'` (should be integer)
2) check model header returned by /v1/embeddings response: `model` field and `model_version`

acme_prod_eng: Ran the checks: 1) lengths: some responses 1536, many 1024. 2) response.model: "rwd-embed-optimized-v3", but our routing layer log shows some X-Model-ID still set to legacy id for in-flight requests.

jessica_ml: Ok that confirms mixed-model traffic. Two mitigation paths:
- Short term: rollback routing to pin to rwd-embed-legacy-v2 so all vectors are 1536 (fast).
- Medium: schedule a backfill to re-embed documents with the new model and update vecdb schema to accept 1024 (requires careful migration + billing/throughput planning).

mike_eng: Implementation notes: we cannot change vecdb's stored vector dims without reindexing. Options: store dimension metadata per-index and reject mismatches at ingest (we currently enforce a single dim). For backfill we can either (A) re-run embeddings for all docs with v3 (costly), or (B) introduce a versioned namespace: index_v2_1536 and index_v3_1024 and switch query layer to search both with appropriate approx options.

acme_prod_eng: Customer preference is to keep service uninterrupted. They prefer a short-term rollback while we craft a backfill plan.

ryan_oncall: Agreed. I'll coordinate a controlled rollback to legacy model on hosted catalog for the customer route only (canary to their org id). Need a support-approved rollback window.

sara_support: I'll schedule rollback and notify billing/CS. Also we need to confirm whether any partial failed batches caused duplicate inserts when retries succeeded — that could create inconsistent doc state. Please capture rows with mismatched dims for cleanup. Query example: `SELECT doc_id, dim, status FROM embeddings_index WHERE org='acme' AND dim != 1536;`

jessica_ml: Repro checklist for eng:
- run curl to embed sample set (n=20) with same batch_size 32 and capture dims
- tail indexer logs with `grep dimension_mismatch` while replaying sample
- verify routing logs map requests to model IDs (routing service has header X-Route-Model)
- check token rotation logs for 02:09 to see if auth failures correlate to partial batch drops

mike_eng: I'll own the logs and auth correlation. Jess, can you validate model artifact metadata to confirm v3 outputs 1024? I can fetch the model manifest from the model-catalog: `/internal/models/rwd-embed-optimized-v3/manifest.json`

jessica_ml: On it — manifest shows output_size: 1024 and quantization: int8-4bit. There was a missing compatibility alias in the rollout (should have created alias rwd-embed-latest -> v3 with backoff).

sara_support: Action items:
- ryan_oncall: schedule canary rollback for this org (owner) — target next 10 min window
- mike_eng: correlate auth spikes and provide list of affected request_ids (owner) — 30m
- jessica_ml: produce backfill cost estimate and propose migration pattern: namespace vs re-embed (owner) — EOD
- acme_prod_eng: hold on running backfills until we confirm plan and rollback

acme_prod_eng: Thanks. One more thing — we've seen latency go from 60ms/token to 400ms/token for some requests. Could that be due to retries and queueing?

mike_eng: Yes, increased retry traffic + indexer backpressure causes queuing in the batching layer and KV cache misses. Once we rollback and remove retry storms latency should normalize. We'll also temporarily bump batch_size to 16 for their route to reduce tail latency.

ryan_oncall: Rolling back now for org=acme (canary). Will post status.

ops_bot: Rollback(event_id=rbk-1998765432-acme) started at 1998765550, status=IN_PROGRESS.

ops_bot: Rollback completed at 1998765650, status=SUCCESS. Route pinned to rwd-embed-legacy-v2 for org=acme.

sara_support: Rollback done, monitoring ingestion now. Please run a quick smoke: embed 10 docs and verify all lengths=1536 and index success.

acme_prod_eng: Smoke looks good — all 10 inserted, lengths=1536, indexer shows no dimension_mismatch. Latency back to ~70ms/token. Thanks.

jessica_ml: I'll draft migration/backfill doc: options, cost, estimated time, and query-side multi-index strategy. Posting in #eng-ml later.

mike_eng: I've attached list of request_ids that saw 401s and retries in the 02:08-02:12 window (pasted to private support ticket).

sara_support: Closing this Slack triage — will follow up with ticket updates and the migration doc. Reopen here if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
